description: Baseline geometry planner: 32/50 successes with 25 remote workers.

description: Tried 65-degree shoulder-pan and live TCP-to-base parking; 12/50, worse than 36/50.

description: Added alternate front-facing live-geometry grasp after straight-arm grasp fails: 38/50.

description: Used fixed-arm screw geometry for initial base staging and live TCP-offset pre-grasp parking: 45/50.

description: Regrasp closes at release pose and validates vertical detachment from tray: 48/50.

asi.next_action: Inspect seeds 35 and 47 final failure geometry; target final counter placement/release dynamics.

description: Lowered post-yaw corrective-drive threshold 0.68→0.60 without changing stance targets: 35/50, unchanged within noise and below baseline.

description: Tried low pre-clear 0.10 before 0.14 with ±30° diagonals: 27/50, worse than 39/50.

asi.next_action_hint: Keep ±30° and 0.14-first. Next target is post-yaw/base re-stance or a safer final vertical grasp geometry; do not reorder pre-clear globally.

asi.result: Full 50/25 completed at 39/50, identical to current best; no measurable gain. Candidate reverted under unchanged-primary rule.
